game_title: Return Or Print – Ice Mill Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round, frost imps strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from frost imps in Ice Mill: keep the court_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: court_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ice Mill'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while court_score > 0.
